newsitem.title: USA: Comsat Corp blames loss on Ascent.
newsitem.headline: Comsat Corp blames loss on Ascent.

text.p: COMSAT Corp said on Monday that its first-quarter loss is due to losses in the sports and entertainment operations of Ascent Entertainment Group Inc, in which COMSAT holds an 81-percent interest that it plans to divest in 1997.
COMSAT reported a first quarter loss of $5.3 million, or $0.11 per share, compared with a profit of $9.3 million, or $0.19 per share, for the same period a year ago.
Excluding Ascent and COMSAT RSI Inc, which the company also plans to divest, COMSAT said it had a first quarter profit of $6.8 million, or $0.14 per share.
COMSAT said it is "on track" to receive an Internal Revenue ruling on the tax-free status of spinning off Ascent to COMSAT shareholders.
Ascent's operating loss for the first quarter was $23.5 million on revenues of $89.9 million, COMSAT said.
